dedupe_keys.name: transport sector final energy demands for european nuts 2 regions including the uk 2024

description: This Zenodo dataset by Antonia Golab gives final energy demand of the transport sector for European NUTS-2 regions, including the United Kingdom, for 2024. National totals come from Eurostat nrg_d_traq for 2023 for most countries, the UK DUKES data for the UK, and the EU Transport Pocketbook 2023 for air and shipping and as a road and rail fallback for Greece, Finland and North Macedonia. Values are projected to 2024 with country growth factors from vehicle stock, population, GDP and transport activity, then downscaled to NUTS-2 using car registrations for road, GDP for rail, airport passengers for air and maritime freight for shipping. The detailed CSV has 20,218 rows for every fuel, sub-mode and region, and an aggregated CSV has 4,782 rows by fuel category, mode and region, with a README and a map. Version 1.0.0 is free under CC BY 4.0, published in February 2026. Coverage is European NUTS-2 regions. Caveats: regional values are proxy-based estimates, not measurements, and source code is only available on request. Simulation uses are regional transport fuel and electricity demand for energy system and charging infrastructure planning. Related records: data-idesignres-heat-demand-district-heating-nuts2 gives heat demand at the same NUTS-2 level.
name: Transport sector final energy demands for European NUTS-2 regions including the UK, 2024
